summary: Examples of user: creating with uid and primary group, creating a home, appending groups, removing with home, generating an SSH key, setting and removing expiry, and password aging settings.
questions: How do I create a user with a specific UID and group?
How do I add a user to extra groups with append?
How do I delete a user and their home directory?
How do I create an SSH key for a user?
How do I set password max age for a user?

answer_card.title: user examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.user: {name: johnd, comment: John Doe, uid: 1040, group: admin}
- ansible.builtin.user:
    name: james
    shell: /bin/bash
    groups: admins,developers
    append: yes
- ansible.builtin.user: {name: johnd, state: absent, remove: yes}
- ansible.builtin.user:
    name: jsmith
    generate_ssh_key: yes
    ssh_key_bits: 2048
    ssh_key_file: .ssh/id_rsa
- ansible.builtin.user: {name: james18, expires: 1422403387}
- ansible.builtin.user: {name: james18, expires: -1}
- ansible.builtin.user: {name: ram19, password_expire_max: 10}
```
